content.title: Paul Thomas Anderson's wife, Maya Rudolph calls the director her ‘husband’ despite no legal marriage; here
content.text: Paul Thomas Anderson added another milestone to his celebrated career after winning his first Oscar for Best Adapted Screenplay for One Battle After Another at the 98th Academy Awards. The victory came after 14 nominations for the filmmaker, who received a standing ovation during the ceremony.The night also saw Ryan Coogler win his first Academy Award, while moving tributes were paid to Robert Redford, Diane Keaton, and Rob Reiner. Meanwhile, Sean Penn won Best Supporting Actor but was absent from the ceremony.But away from the Oscars stage, interest around paul thomas anderson often extends beyond his films to his long-standing relationship with actor and comedian Maya Rudolph. Despite being together for more than two decades and raising four children, the couple has never legally married, yet Rudolph still calls Anderson her husband.Also Read: Amy Madigan’s ‘Weapons’ Oscar 2026 win ends a 32-year drought and it breaks another record tooWhy Maya Rudolph calls Paul Thomas Anderson her husbandAnderson and Rudolph have been together for more than 25 years, forming one of Hollywood’s most enduring power couples. The couple share four children, Pearl, Lucille, Jack and Minnie and Rudolph has appeared in two of Anderson’s films.Even though they never formally married, Rudolph has long referred to the filmmaker as her husband in everyday life. During a September 2018 interview with The New York Times, she explained why the terminology changed after they started a family."I felt 'ooky' calling Anderson her boyfriend after the birth of their first child," she said, adding that she has been referring to him as her husband ever since. "People know what that means. It means he's the father of my child, and I live with him, and we are a couple, and we are not going anywhere," she said to the outlet, as quoted by PEOPLE.Since then, the description has stuck. Rudolph continues to call Anderson her husband in conversation, even though the pair have never pursued legal marriage.Paul Thomas Anderson’s celebrated film careerOutside of his personal life, paul thomas anderson remains one of the most influential filmmakers in Hollywood. The director is widely known for auteur-driven dramas that have defined modern American cinema.Among the most acclaimed paul anderson movies are There Will Be Blood, Boogie Nights, Magnolia, and Phantom Thread, films that have earned widespread critical acclaim and numerous award nominations.His latest Oscar win further cements his reputation as one of the industry’s leading storytellers. And while fans often search for details about paul thomas anderson wife, Rudolph’s own explanation makes it clear that for the couple, commitment has never depended on a marriage certificate.
